items.title: Liberal frontbencher pushes back on coalition with One Nation

items.title: International experts weigh in on Australia’s bird flu response
items.description: While the H5N1 bird flu strain is relatively new to Australia, experts who have monitored the spread in other continents say surveillance is key to tackling the deadly virus.

items.title: Woman charged with murder after child found dead in NSW Central Coast home

items.title: Taylor Swift's wedding a lesson in 'media mastery'
